header: One mast, four sensors, twelve years of readings
bodytext:
A Marnau station is simple: a galvanised mast on the bank, a sealed logger box, four probes on a cable and a solar panel. The panel has to survive a winter in the shade of willows. Nothing on the mast is custom-made. A part that cannot be replaced from a van will one day stop the series.

Every station records a reading every 15 minutes and sends its readings over the mobile network once an hour. It keeps a local copy for 90 days. Each winter, two or three masts go silent. We fill the gap from the local copy at the next visit instead of estimating it.
